text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I did it...!
I'm the Derby Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that?! This is me!
The real "Gold City"...!
(WOOAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gold City is incredible!!
Her skill is the real deal... I can't wait to see her wearing the winner's sash!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? Red would definitely suit her! It'd look so good!
Now I'm really looking forward to the final Kikuka Sho~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, even though you're a model, you're amazing!
You're so cool, City!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? I already won the Derby.
So what's all this about leis and modeling—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Still, her running is incredible too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Is that what it was all about?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not just 'is' running,
running 'as well'...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, you just can't surpass me?
Surpass this doll of myself...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: You really showed some great running out there!
That was a great run you showed us!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe even that is pointless.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Not just a pretty face,"
"Even though she's a model"...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"My evaluation
definitely includes my looks."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then... in the end,
nothing's changed from before.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All I want... is for you
to look only at me...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if it was like this at the Derby...
Could it be that...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Beyond this, it's—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: I'm going to become the strongest Umamusume.
I'm going to become the strongest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
The Kikuka Sho...

They say the Kikuka-sho is won by the strongest Umamusume.
If she displays overwhelming power, she might just rewrite everyone's expectations.
choice_data_list: I don't want it to end like this either—it's frustrating
I'd be frustrated too if it ended like this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: I want everyone around to realize just how strong you are!
I want everyone around to realize just how strong you are!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I might've been getting a bit discouraged.
I'm fine now. I'm not gonna quit halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It'd be totally uncool
if you were more fired up than me.
choice_data_list: I'll definitely make you stronger before summer's over!
I'll definitely make you stronger before summer's over!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
You said it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then I promise too.
...That I'll answer that fiery passion of yours.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll get stronger and win the Kikuka Sho.
And this time, I'll carve the real me
into their memories for good...!"
